Engraving is a paid add-on, not free. Link a lightweight Shopify product below (e.g. "Gravare personalizată") and its price will be charged automatically as a second cart line whenever a customer types engraving text. Until you link a product, the placeholder price is shown but nothing is charged.

settings.label: Placeholder price (shown until a product is linked)

settings.content: Sets the order products appear in on the homepage and on /collections/all ("Toate produsele"). Shopify has no drag-and-drop order for this automatic "all products" listing, so type the exact product name (as it appears in Products), one per line, in the order you want. Those products show first, in that order; every product you don't list still shows, right after, in its usual order. A misspelled name is simply skipped (that product isn't pinned, nothing breaks).

settings.content: A set on offer, shown across the shop: homepage banner, top bar, its product card, its product page, the product pages of its pieces and the cart. The saving is the pieces' real prices added up minus the set price, and it only shows once every piece has a price. Leave the product empty to stop the offer everywhere.

settings.label: Pieces sold only in the set (optional)

settings.content: To put any product on sale: in Products, set Price to the new price and Compare-at price to the old price. The shop then shows -X% and the old price crossed out on the cards, the product page and in the cart. By law (EU / ANPC) the crossed-out price must be the lowest price you charged in the last 30 days.

The courier prices shown on product pages, in the cart and on the Livrare page. They only change what the site shows: checkout charges what is set in Settings → Shipping and delivery, so when you change a price here, change it there too (same name, same price). Leave a courier's name empty to hide it.
